tax_litigation.status: The appeal is pending with CIT(Appeals).

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company had received demand letter(s) regarding the assessment of the Limestone Royalty re-assessment calculated for the period:- (a) 1995-96 to 2001-02 amounting to Rs. 1.59 Crores. (b) 2002-03 to 2008-09 amounting to Rs. 1.18 Crores (c) 2009-10 to 2012-13 amounting to Rs. 1.22 Crores Further, Company has received demand letter(s) to deposit the interest calculated over above re-assessment:- (a) 1995-96 to 2001-02 amounting to Rs. 2.81 Crores. (b) additional interest amount of Rs. 1.71 Crores basis CAG Report against the Limestone royalty re-assessment for the period 1995-96 to 2001-02.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Mines & Geology, Govt. of Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: Company had filed writ petition(s) with Hon'ble High Court, Rajasthan and same are pending. Company has deposited Rs. 5.58 Crores (1.59 Crores + Rs. 2.81 Crores + Rs. 1.18 Crores) under protest. On 21.01.2023 Company has received letters from M.E Ramganjmandi regarding withdrawal of Re-Assessment Order dated 16.06.2004 for period 1995-96 to 2001-02. Further, on 15.11.2025 Company has filed writ petition with High Court, Jaipur for withdrawal of S.B Civil writ petition no. 4597/2004 for period from 1995-96 to 2001-02 and for appropriate directions regarding refund of amount deposited under protest. (Deposited amount to be refunded= 1.59 + 2.81 = 4.4 Crores and Additional demand towards interest 1.70 Crores to be withdrawn automatically.) But Writ petition filed in the High Court, Jaipur for the period from 2002-03 to 2013-14 regarding conversion factor matter remains the same.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company has received a demand letter dated 03.03.2025 from Mining Engineer Ramganjmandi regarding royalty assessment of Limestone from 2013-14 to 2023-24 demanding royalty, DMFT and NMET amounting to Rs. 11.27 Crores. Company on 30.07.2025 has further received a revised Demand letter w.r.t. DMFT and the same has been reduced to from Rs. 5.20 Crores to Rs. 89.51 Lacs.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Mines & Geology, Govt. of Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: The company has filed Writ petition with Hon'ble High Court, Rajasthan and as per Directions of Hon’ble High Court, Jaipur Company has under protest deposited Rs. 3.03 Crores i.e. 50% of the total outstanding amount except the amount under the Head of DMFT.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company has received a notice from Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd. (RRVUNL) demanding Rs. 17.84 Crores plus GST for payment of differential amount towards price of fly ash from 01.01.2015 in terms of the Judgment dated 19.01.2017 passed by Hon'ble Supreme Court, referring arbitral award dated 18.02.2015 as also the order dated 17.05.2015 passed by the Arbitral Tribunal being set aside by the Common Judgment dated 13.09.2022 passed by Learned Commercial Court No. 4, Jaipur Metropolitan II, Jaipur.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd.
tax_litigation.status: Company has filed substitute arbitration application no. 117/2022 for seeking substitution of sole arbitrator in place of previous sole arbitrator. Company and RRVUNL, both had also filed Civil Misc. Appeal(s) partly challenging order dated 13.09.2022 passed by the Commercial Court, Jaipur. And said matters disposed vide Order dated 14.10.2025 and the Hon'ble High Court is set-aside the Order dated 13.09.2022 passed by the Commercial Court under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The proceedings under Section 34 of the Act of 1996, are restored to their original stage. The learned Commercial Court is directed to decide the same afresh, strictly in accordance with law and keeping in view the observations of the Hon’ble Supreme Court in Gayatri Balasamy. The Commercial Court, Jaipur heard cases CIS-368/2019 (MCL vs RRVUNL) & CIS-369/2019 (RRVUNL vs MCL) and disposed of the matters vide its order dated 06.03.2026.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed by Company on 25.06.2024 against the final assessment order dated 31.05.2024 u/s 143(3) r.w.s.144C (13) & r.w.s.144B issued by Faceless Assessment Unit of Income Tax Department for A.Y. 2020-21 for addition of Rs 4,616.39 Lakhs towards 80IA TP adjustment. The Company has not claimed 80IA deduction in A.Y. 2020-21 due to carried forward unabsorbed depreciation and Business Losses of Rs. 34,086.52 Lakhs. The 80IA issue of TP Adjustment already decided in our favour by ITAT, Jaipur Bench vide order dated 28.11.2022 in AY 2018-19. However, tax liability of Rs. 1,613.15 Lakhs may arise in future assessment years in case the appeal is decided against the Company.
tax_litigation.status: The Appeal decided in our favour vide order dated 15.01.25 by ITAT, Jaipur Bench. The Principal Commissioner Income Tax, Udaipur, has preferred an appeal before the Rajasthan High Court (Jaipur Bench) challenging the order of the ITAT dated 15.01.25 passed under Section 254 of the Income Tax Act, 1961.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal filed by Company on 18.11.2024 against the final assessment order dated 19.09.2024 u/s 143(3) r.w.s.144C (13) & r.w.s.144B issued by Faceless Assessment Unit of Income Tax Department for A.Y. 2021-22 for addition of Rs. 4864.38 Lakhs towards 80IA TP adjustment. The Company have not claimed 80IA deduction in A.Y. 2021-22 due to carried forward unabsorbed depreciation of Rs. 23,066.46 Lakhs. The 80IA issue of TP Adjustment already decided in our favour by ITAT, Jaipur Bench vide order dated 28.11.2022 in A.Y. 2018-19. No Regular tax liability arise in Assessment Year 2021-22 due to carried forward unabsorbed depreciation of Rs. 23,066.46 Lakhs. However, tax liability of Rs. 1,699.81 Lakhs may arise in future assessment years in case the appeal is decided against the Company.
tax_litigation.status: The Appeal decided in Company's favour vide order dated 28.04.25 by ITAT, Jaipur Bench.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal has been filed by GST Dept. with Honourable Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur against the CESTAT Delhi order dated 24.07.2017 decided in the favour of Company for Cenvat Credit & Input Service tax credit availed by the Company amounting to Rs. 1,378.12 Lacs.
tax_litigation.status: The said Case is pending at Honourable Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Appeal has been filed by GST Dept. with Hon'ble Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur against the CESTAT Delhi order dated 28.09.2017 decided in the favour of Company for Service Tax Credit availed by the Company amounting to Rs. 338.45 lacs.
tax_litigation.status: Appeal is pending with Hon'ble Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company has filed an appeal with CESTAT Delhi against the order dated 08.02.2020 passed by Commissioner, GST Deptt. Udaipur for Service Tax Credit availed by the Company amounting to Rs. 291.19 lacs.
tax_litigation.status: CESTAT Delhi set aside the impugned order and remand the matters back to the adjudicating authority for verification and instructed to pass an appropriate order in accordance with law within sixty days of production of the mining lease agreements by the appellant after giving an opportunity of being heard to the appellant. Company has filed an application with adjudicating authority.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company has filed an appeal with Commissioner Appeal Jodhpur against the order dated 16.01.2025 passed by Deputy Commissioner, GST Deptt. Kota for Input Service Tax Credit availed by the Company amounting to Rs. 347.30 lacs.
tax_litigation.status: Appeal is pending with Ho’ble Commissioner Appeal Jodhpur

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company has made an appeal to CIT(A) on 16th October 2025 w.r.t. A.Y. 2020-21 alleging JAO has erred in not granting interest to the extent of Rs. 1,23,11,343 under section 244A of the Income Tax Act by incorrectly computing the interest only for 14 months as against 56 months.
tax_litigation.status: The appeal is pending with CIT(Appeals).

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company had received demand letter(s) regarding the assessment of the Limestone Royalty re-assessment calculated for the period:- (a) 1995-96 to 2001-02 amounting to Rs. 1.59 Crores. (b) 2002-03 to 2008-09 amounting to Rs. 1.18 Crores (c) 2009-10 to 2012-13 amounting to Rs. 1.22 Crores Further, Company has received demand letter(s) to deposit the interest calculated over above re-assessment:- (a) 1995-96 to 2001-02 amounting to Rs. 2.81 Crores. (b) additional interest amount of Rs. 1.71 Crores basis CAG Report against the Limestone royalty re-assessment for the period 1995-96 to 2001-02.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Mines & Geology, Govt. of Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: Company had filed writ petition(s) with Hon'ble High Court, Rajasthan and same are pending. Company has deposited Rs. 5.58 Crores (1.59 Crores + Rs. 2.81 Crores + Rs. 1.18 Crores) under protest. On 21.01.2023 Company has received letters from M.E Ramganjmandi regarding withdrawal of Re-Assessment Order dated 16.06.2004 for period 1995-96 to 2001-02. Further, on 15.11.2025 Company has filed writ petition with High Court, Jaipur for withdrawal of S.B Civil writ petition no. 4597/2004 for period from 1995-96 to 2001-02 and for appropriate directions regarding refund of amount deposited under protest. (Deposited amount to be refunded= 1.59 + 2.81 = 4.4 Crores and Additional demand towards interest 1.70 Crores to be withdrawn automatically.) But Writ petition filed in the High Court, Jaipur for the period from 2002-03 to 2013-14 regarding conversion factor matter remains the same.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company has received a demand letter dated 03.03.2025 from Mining Engineer Ramganjmandi regarding royalty assessment of Limestone from 2013-14 to 2023-24 demanding royalty, DMFT and NMET amounting to Rs. 11.27 Crores. Company on 30.07.2025 has further received a revised Demand letter w.r.t. DMFT and the same has been reduced to from Rs. 5.20 Crores to Rs. 89.51 Lacs.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Department of Mines & Geology, Govt. of Rajasthan
tax_litigation.status: The company has filed Writ petition with Hon'ble High Court, Rajasthan and as per Directions of Hon’ble High Court, Jaipur Company has under protest deposited Rs. 3.03 Crores i.e. 50% of the total outstanding amount except the amount under the Head of DMFT.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Company had received a notice from Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd. (RRVUNL) demanding Rs. 17.84 Crores plus GST for payment of differential amount towards price of fly ash. Company has filed substitute arbitration application no. 117/2022 for seeking substitution of sole arbitrator in place of previous sole arbitrator. Company and RRVUNL, both had also filed Civil Misc. Appeal(s) partly challenging order dated 13.09.2022 passed by the Commercial Court, Jaipur. And said matters disposed vide Order dated 14.10.2025 and the Hon'ble High Court is set-aside the Order dated 13.09.2022 passed by the Commercial Court under Section 34 of the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996. The proceedings under Section 34 of the Act of 1996, are restored to their original stage. The learned Commercial Court is directed to decide the same afresh, strictly in accordance with law and keeping in view the observations of the Hon’ble Supreme Court in Gayatri Balasamy. The Commercial Court, Jaipur heard cases CIS-368/2019 (MCL vs RRVUNL) and CIS-369/2019 (RRVUNL vs MCL) and disposed of the matters through its order dated 06.03.2026. RRVUNL has filed two new Civil Misc. Appeal Nos. 2425/2026 & 2363/2026 both titled 'Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd. V/s Mangalam Cement Ltd.' under Section 37 of the Arbitration & Conciliation Act, 1996 (as amended) before the Hon'ble High Court of Rajasthan, Jaipur Bench, Jaipur challenging the Order dated 6.3.2026 passed by the Ld. Commercial Court, Jaipur Metropolitan-II, Jaipur, which are tagged along with S.B. Arbitration Application No. 117/2022 titled 'Mangalam Cement Ltd. V/s Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd.
tax_litigation.opposing_party: Rajasthan Rajya Vidyut Utpadan Nigam Ltd.
tax_litigation.status: Presently matter related to Arbitration Application no. 117 of 2022 connected with Civil Misc. Appeal Nos. 2425/2026 & 2363/2026 are pending before the Hon’ble Rajasthan High Court, Jaipur Bench.

operating_notes.text: Mangalam Cement was declared preferred bidder for the Minyun Ki Dhani Main limestone mining lease in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan, in an e-auction held 21 April 2026; lease grant is pending.
Q4FY26 exceptional item: 50% provision of ₹20.52 Cr on a Petcoke advance to a foreign supplier; part payment of AED 1.80 million received and legal proceedings initiated in an overseas court.
The company opted for Section 115BAA from FY27 at a 25.168% effective rate, remeasuring deferred tax and booking a ₹54.08 Cr net reversal in Q4FY26.
FY26 capex was ₹348.20 Cr against operating cash flow of ₹93.97 Cr; borrowings rose to ₹869.58 Cr at Mar-2026 from ₹614.92 Cr a year earlier.
